sections.Profile:
"Twinky" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company on July 18, 1967. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two kick-out holes, two rollunder lanes, and two slingshots. The artwork, designed by Christian Marche, depicts a television studio, with the peacock motif referencing the NBC television network.
